cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of path-one-host-outline (lab-mcp-host-configuration-planner) with contract handoff to official-runtime-readiness-checker
cases.inputPrompt: A user has Blender 5.1 installed and wants to understand Path 1 host (a) Anthropic Connector in Claude Desktop vs host (b) manual Lab MCP server configuration in Cursor. Use path-one-host-outline.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (path_one_host_option) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces path_one_host_architecture_outline, connector_not_standalone_boundary_check, host_to_readiness_handoff for role lab-mcp-host-configuration-planner
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to official-runtime-readiness-checker (Readiness probing)
forbiddenOutputProperties: Connector is standalone without Blender add-on
evidenceRequirements: Outputs path_one_host_architecture_outline, connector_not_standalone_boundary_check, host_to_readiness_handoff conforming to skills/path-one-host-outline/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to official-runtime-readiness-checker in skills/path-one-host-outline/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete path_one_host_architecture_outline and hand off to official-runtime-readiness-checker (Readiness probing).
simulatedOutput.summary: Outlined Path 1 Blender-side prerequisite (Blender Lab MCP add-on in Blender 5.1+) and compared host (a) Claude Desktop Connector vs host (b) manual MCP client config. Delivered Blender Lab MCP add-on, Blender 5.1+, host (a) vs host (b) and routed to official-runtime-readiness-checker.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.inputPrompt: While applying path-one-host-outline, the workflow context is {"runtime.conflictDetected":true} (Bridge conflicts). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the fallback handoff predicate in skills/path-one-host-outline/contract.json
Routes to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver (Bridge conflicts) without claiming runtime execution
forbiddenOutputProperties: Connector is standalone without Blender add-on
evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver (Bridge conflicts).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from path-one-host-outline to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver under context {"runtime.conflictDetected":true}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in path-one-host-outline
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during path-one-host-outline with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for path-one-host-outline and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for path-one-host-outline.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (path_one_host_option) for path-one-host-outline halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Outline Path 1 host configuration when the user has not confirmed whether they have Blender 5.1+ or which MCP client host they want to connect.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'path_one_host_option' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing Blender 5.1+ version confirmation and target MCP host application required by path-one-host-outline (path_one_host_option)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: Blender 5.1+ version confirmation and target MCP host application
forbiddenOutputProperties: Connector is standalone without Blender add-on
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'path_one_host_option' (Blender 5.1+ version confirmation and target MCP host application)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing Blender 5.1+ version confirmation and target MCP host application (path_one_host_option) before path-one-host-outline locks path_one_host_architecture_outline.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted path-one-host-outline due to missing required input 'path_one_host_option' (Blender 5.1+ version confirmation and target MCP host application); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent Blender 5.1+ version confirmation and target MCP host application when 'path_one_host_option' is omitted.

expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/path-one-host-outline/contract.json when choosing between Path 1, Path 2, or CLI

forbiddenOutputProperties: Connector is standalone without Blender add-on

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for path-one-host-outline (choosing between Path 1, Path 2, or CLI); delegate to runtime-path-picker.
